### Q1
No. The plain-text JSON file store (data/store.json) stays, because ops' nightly rsync job diffs plain-text files and a binary SQLite file would break their backup checks. The performance fix is to debounce writes by 200 ms in src/store.ts and call flush() on shutdown.

### Q2
Yes, `src/legacy/` must never be modified. It is vendored from the old logistics monolith, and the platform team's sync job overwrites it every Monday, so any change would be silently lost.

### Q3
The HMAC goes in a top-level JSON body field `sig`. It is the hex HMAC-SHA256 (secret from env ERP_WEBHOOK_SECRET) over the body without `sig`, with `sig` appended last. Without a secret, the webhook goes out unsigned. Earlier we tried an X-Signature header, but the gateway strips all custom X- headers.

### Q4
Port 9911, since the October infra move. docs/erp-api.md, the README and config/default.json still say 8080.

### Q5
Every new user-facing error `message` must be in German, because the warehouse UI shows it verbatim to packers. The `code` stays English SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE. Old English messages are left as they are.

### Q6
It uses a hardcoded Austrian holiday list for 2026 and 2027 in src/services/holidays.ts, because the deployment has no outbound internet. Outside those years only weekends are skipped, so the list must be extended before 2028.

### Q7
No. We tried batching in September, sending an array of up to 50 events per POST. The ERP answers 422 to any array and only accepts one event object per request.

### Q8
No new npm dependencies, not even dev dependencies, because each one needs a roughly 6-week security review. Node 24 runs TypeScript directly, so the project has zero dependencies.

### Q9
Yes, memoizing `calculateEta` was tried. QA saw stale ETAs after a new tracking event because the cache wasn't invalidated, and the cache key got messy. It was removed completely and shouldn't be re-added. The plan is to paginate GET /shipments later instead.

### Q10
Retries are capped at 3 attempts in total, with a fixed 30 s delay and no exponential backoff. The ERP only dedups by event_id within a 2-minute window. We retry only on network errors, timeouts and 5xx responses, not 4xx. The delay is injectable, and the worst case is 75 s with a 5 s timeout.

### Q11
Never log recipient name, address, phone or any other recipient field, anywhere. This is GDPR personal data, flagged by the DPO in last month's audit. Shipment IDs and tracking numbers are fine to log.

### Q12
Yes, 'emits webhook on delivered' in test/events.test.ts fails about 1 run in 5 on CI because of a timer race in the fake notifier (OPS-412). If it fails, rerun once and don't try to fix it, since the platform team owns the fix.

### Q13
Only ATP numbers get UPU S10 check-digit validation (src/lib/s10.ts, code INVALID_TRACKING_NUMBER). Every other carrier accepts any non-empty value, because formats change and valid DHL numbers were rejected for 2 days last year. /import uses the same validator.

### Q14
Hot reload of config/default.json is a future item, and nothing needs building now. `fs.watch` never fires on staging, because change events don't propagate through the Docker bind mount from the Windows host. `fs.watchFile` (polling) works.

### Q15
Yes, GET /shipments/:id must not change at all, with no added, removed or renamed fields. The mobile app v2.3 parses it with a strict schema and crashes on unknown or missing fields, and the next release is in January. Don't touch the `shipmentToApi()` fields or that route's body. Only the list endpoint gets `eta`.
Nothing in that message qualifies for the ledger. It was a recall quiz, and it didn't state any new rule, decision, dead end or fact.
